Asset type: portrait public-interest poster, first visual draft for a retained design iteration.
Primary request: Create an original Chinese civic-mobility poster for the real brief “文明出行公益海报”, about yielding to pedestrians at a zebra crossing. This is version 1 of a design process, a credible first draft with room for later simplification, already a real designed poster.
Scene/backdrop: a warm off-white paper background, a simplified blue Shanghai-inspired city skyline near the bottom, a single stationary coral-red car clearly stopped BEFORE a zebra crossing, two small pedestrians crossing safely.
Subject: a broad diagonal dark-blue roadway with white zebra crossing bands opening into generous space, visually expressing giving someone room.
Style/medium: contemporary Chinese graphic poster, sophisticated flat editorial illustration, subtly printed paper texture, strong clean geometric forms, no photography, no mockup scene.
Composition/framing: vertical A3-like proportion, entire flat artwork edge to edge. Main crossing occupies the middle/lower area, headline at top left. Include a few small arrows and city detail in this first version, while keeping road and people readable.
Color palette: deep ink blue, warm ivory, coral red, muted pale blue.
Text (verbatim): headline “文明出行，让一步” ; small footer “礼让行人 · 从一次停下开始”.
Constraints: Simplified Chinese text spelled correctly, original illustration, no fake organizer logo, no event date, no author name, no watermark, no decorative English, no claims of contest endorsement. Preserve safe driving logic: car does not overlap pedestrians and stops before the crossing. Create one portrait image.

Palette: deep ink blue, warm ivory, coral red, small muted pale blue accents.
